title: Aspect Deep 3: Completion and Sudden-Event Adverbs
description: Beyond уже and наконец. The B1 completion family adds наконец-то, мгновенно, вдруг, неожиданно, and the 'успеть + СВ' construction. All push you toward the perfective.
descriptionRussian: За пределами 'уже' и 'наконец'. На уровне B1 добавляются 'наконец-то', 'мгновенно', 'вдруг', 'неожиданно' и конструкция 'успеть + СВ'. Все они требуют совершенного вида.
intro: The mirror family: adverbs that mark a finished result, a single fast moment, or something happening out of nowhere. All three pull the perfective for the same underlying reason, which is that each describes one bounded event rather than a stretch of time. One verb here is worth learning as a frame in its own right, because it means 'managed to get it done in time' and always takes a perfective.
rules: Emphatic completion adverbs (наконец, наконец-то, уже) describe a finished result and trigger the perfective.
Fast / instant completion adverbs (сразу, сразу же, быстро, мгновенно) describe a single bounded moment and trigger the perfective.
Suddenness adverbs (вдруг, неожиданно, внезапно) introduce a single unexpected event into the narrative and trigger the perfective.
Успеть takes a perfective infinitive: 'Я успел прочитать статью.' The construction expresses 'managed to complete X in time.'
examples: Маша наконец-то прочитала эту книгу. (Masha finally finished this book.) Наконец-то → СВ.
Антон вдруг понял, что забыл ключ. (Anton suddenly realized he had forgotten the key.) Вдруг → СВ.
Я мгновенно ответил на её вопрос. (I (m) instantly answered her question.) Мгновенно → СВ.
Лена сразу же написала ответ. (Lena wrote a reply right away.) Сразу же → СВ.
Они быстро приготовили обед. (They quickly cooked dinner.) Быстро → СВ.
Я успел прочитать статью до встречи. (I (m) managed to read the article before the meeting.) Успеть + СВ infinitive.

items.prompt: По выходным мы _____ старые фильмы у бабушки.
items.promptEnglish: On weekends we watched old films at Grandma's.
items.hint: Recap from Lesson 2: 'по выходным' is which kind of cue?
items.explanation: Recap from Lesson 2: 'по выходным' is a habitual time pattern and triggers the imperfective. Past plural -ли: смотрели. Today's lesson moves to the OPPOSITE family: completion and suddenness, both → perfective.

items.promptEnglish: Masha finally finished this long book.
items.hint: Наконец-то marks emphatic completion. Past fem.
items.explanation: Наконец-то (finally, at long last) is an emphatic completion adverb: the speaker is registering that the action is finally done. Past fem -ла: прочитала.

items.prompt: Антон вдруг _____, что забыл ключ дома.
items.promptEnglish: Anton suddenly realized he had forgotten the key at home.
items.hint: Вдруг introduces what kind of event into the narrative?
items.explanation: Вдруг (suddenly) introduces a single unexpected event. The realization happens in one bounded moment, which is the perfective picture. Past masc -л: понял.
Мгновенно (instantly) describes a single bounded moment of completion. Perfective ответил, masc -л.

items.promptEnglish: They quickly cooked dinner and left.
items.explanation: Быстро (quickly) is a fast-completion adverb: the action reached its result in a short span. The narrative also moves on ('и ушли'), confirming the completion. Perfective plural -ли: приготовили.

items.promptEnglish: I (m) managed to read the article before the meeting.
items.hint: 'Managed to read' = успеть in the past. Single completed framing.
items.explanation: Успеть means 'manage to complete in time' and is itself a perfective verb. The construction is 'успеть + perfective infinitive.' Past masc: успел + прочитать.

blanks: Лена сразу же _____ на письмо. (Lena wrote a reply right away.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Сразу же (immediately, right at that moment) is a fast-completion adverb. The reply is finished in a single bounded moment. Perfective past fem -ла: написала.

errorCorrection.sentence: Вчера на вокзале Лена неожиданно встречала старого друга.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Yesterday at the station, Lena unexpectedly met an old friend.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'Неожиданно' (unexpectedly) introduces a single unforeseen event, which is the perfective picture, so встретила. The imperfective встречала would describe meeting as a repeated or ongoing process ('used to meet', 'was meeting'), which clashes with a one-off surprise. Suddenness adverbs (вдруг, неожиданно, внезапно) all select the perfective.

errorCorrection.sentence: Когда заиграла музыка, Маша сразу вспоминала тот вечер.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: When the music started playing, Masha immediately remembered that evening.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'Сразу' (right away) marks completion in a single bounded moment, so the perfective вспомнила. The imperfective вспоминала would describe remembering as a drawn-out or repeated process ('kept recalling'), which clashes with an instant 'right away'. Fast-completion adverbs (сразу, быстро, мгновенно) all select the perfective.

errorCorrection.sentence: В поезде Антон успел читать всю книгу.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: On the train, Anton managed to read the whole book.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'Успеть' means 'to manage to complete something in time' and governs a perfective infinitive, so успел прочитать. The imperfective читать would frame reading as an open-ended process, which contradicts успеть's 'got it done' meaning, especially with 'всю книгу' (the whole book). The pairing is fixed: успеть + perfective infinitive.

minimalPairs.explanation: Наконец-то marks emphatic completion: dinner is finally done. Perfective приготовила, fem -ла. The imperfective готовила would describe the process without registering the result, which 'finally cooked' rules out.

minimalPairs.context: Антон вдруг _____ её голос в коридоре.
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Anton suddenly heard her voice in the hallway.
minimalPairs.explanation: Вдруг introduces a single unexpected event. Perfective услышал, masc -л. The imperfective слышал would describe an ongoing or repeated hearing, which 'suddenly' rules out.

categorySorting.instruction: Sort these cues by which aspect they trigger.

reviewVocab.definition: finally, at long last (emphatic completion adverb; carries emotional weight; triggers the perfective)
instantly (fast-completion adverb; triggers the perfective because instant action is by nature a single bounded moment)
reviewVocab.example: Я мгновенно понял, что он ошибся.

reviewVocab.definition: to manage to do something in time (perfective verb; takes a perfective infinitive: 'успел прочитать')
reviewVocab.example: Я успел прочитать статью до встречи.
